obfuscation_indicators: subjective nature of costs and timing
risk_summary: The disclosure is largely standard MD&A boilerplate, combining operational descriptions and positive management assertions with limited quantified discussion of COVID-19 effects. Key risks include uncertain pandemic impacts, client procurement and collection delays, contract caps and renegotiations, off-balance-sheet guarantees, and subjective tax-payment timing, although management presents liquidity and continuity as adequate.
